description: AI-powered Mission Control console that solves one of NASA’s greatest engineering bottlenecks for permanent lunar exploration: safely connecting sunlit solar ridges to ice-rich Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) at the Lunar South Pole. By fusing real NASA Moon Trek spatial imagery, three specialized TensorFlow neural networks, and an interactive 3D terrain & shadow CAD inspector, it empowers mission planners to pinpoint safe habitat pads and plot obstacle-free power and water supply routes.
